ideas.title: I walk across my own pages
ideas.critique: The character leaving the game to walk over the blog text as a matted, path traced video is new: it changes what the pages are, not what happens on the island. Risk: it is a film on a page, so it must truly overlay the text and not read as one more post.

ideas.title: Gone to dust
ideas.critique: Lumi-only transformation with a chase and a payoff, like the shadow and flight events, but a wind-driven particle body is a new way of moving and fits the physics goal. Friends catching bits is the familiar chase gag.

ideas.title: The sky is a mirror
ideas.critique: A live inverted copy of the island overhead resembles the live miniature mirror of the other game, but it is a different relation to the world and strikingly visual. A shown still or film is the likely form, which weakens the 'changes how the island works' claim.

ideas.title: The island in a snow globe
ideas.critique: A pull-back reveal that reframes the island as an object is a real twist and a good path-tracing showcase with glass. It is a one-off film with no lasting change, and the workshop link echoes earlier workshop posts.

ideas.title: Hear where you look
ideas.critique: A permanent sound layer driven by actions is what The island plays itself already did; camera-positional ambience is a step, but not a new kind. Also hard to show in a post and unheard in the test rig.

ideas.title: X-ray afternoon
ideas.critique: A render mode revealing insides is a new way of seeing, and the dig-up payoff gives it play. It is still an island-wide afternoon event with a gather-and-react ending, and the buried-treasure dig is a predictable payoff.

ideas.title: My camera gets curious
ideas.critique: The explicit next mood of the mood camera just posted: same mechanism, same film shape, a different behaviour. The judge will see it as the same recipe.

ideas.title: Walking giant
ideas.critique: Giant mode already exists, and a walk with thumps and friends bouncing is an extension of it plus a user wish. The consequences ring is a good physics touch but predictable.

ideas.title: A spell I can't undo
ideas.critique: A rule changing the scale of everyone for an hour is the same kind as the slow-time rings and the rewind: a world rule imposed on all friends. The pebble-sized view of the island is a strong visual twist, and the stuck undo is a nice gag.

ideas.title: Shell learns tag
ideas.critique: A gathering gag with a comic failure of one participant and a punchline, the same recipe as PIE and the miss-me post. The game mutating into Shell's rules is the best part, but it is still one more event with Shell.
